description: This PHP file defines the HTMLPurifier_Bootstrap class, which provides meta-functionality such as autoloading classes for the HTML Purifier project. It contains methods for dynamically loading class files, path resolution for classes, and registering the autoload function within PHP's SPL autoload stack.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_Bootstrap
classes.description: Contains static methods to facilitate autoloading and path resolution for HTML Purifier classes.

methods.name: autoload
methods.description: Autoloads a class by resolving its file path and including it if it exists.

methods.name: getPath
methods.description: Returns the filesystem path to the class PHP file based on class name conventions.

methods.name: registerAutoload
methods.description: Registers the autoload method with PHP's SPL autoload stack, optionally prepending it.
